new_references.caption: The Guild.
new_references.scene: Guild grounds: daylight bridge and circular-windowed stone tower
visible_findings: Right bridge has a timber-colored plank deck between broad continuous parapets that rise toward the middle, with curling dark motifs on pale inset faces and chunky capped end posts.
A tall post lantern stands immediately outside the near right bridge end.
Part of a second decorated bridge is visible at the far left edge beyond practice dummies.
The tower has large round inset/window features, pointed gables above them, heavy horizontal bands and an upper polygonal stage.
limits: Hero, trees, rocks and image boundaries occlude the approach and left bridge.
No calibrated bridge width, slope, parapet thickness, coordinate orientation, lighting value or two-actor clearance follows from this view.

new_references.caption: The guild :3
new_references.scene: Guild main map hall: stair, under-stair arch and Cullis gate
visible_findings: Stone stairs rise behind a thick timber handrail and broadly spaced timber posts; the stair base spans a pointed stone passage.
A separate pointed doorway behind the stair foot contains the blue Cullis effect.
Red carpet bands connect the doorways around a relief-map table above diagonal-pattern stone paving.
The upper hall has a continuous curved masonry band and a projecting dark timber floor/edge above the stair.

new_references.caption: HEROES GUILD
new_references.scene: Guild courtyard and watercourse: wide elevated panorama
visible_findings: Two decorated timber bridge spans cross separate visible portions of the watercourse beyond the formal courtyard.
Low straight hedges divide clipped trees and two visible tiered fountain basins; a stone-paved route runs beside the watercourse.
Long Guild masonry walls have repeated buttress-like strips and slate-colored roofs; round windows sit beneath roof projections on the near right building.
The two bridge spans show deck planks and continuous rising decorated side members from above.

visible_findings: The scenic mountains are separate low irregular silhouettes in front of the large painted panel; taller multi-peak forms occur at left and lower forms at right.
A large crenellated tower silhouette stands forward at right with a narrow dark inset/slit; two smaller castle-wall-like forms are visible deeper in the range, partly hidden by targets.
There are real visual gaps between scenery depth layers and straw target forms; the foreground tower is not simply painted onto the rear board.
The dirt shooting platform is bounded in the foreground by a curved brown timber strip, while the green-brown transverse divider stands farther toward the scenery.

future_pass_recommendation.priority: Separate shallow scenic silhouettes ahead of the existing archery board, starting with a low stepped mountain cue and a small crenellated tower cue; undertake only a scratch footprint/collision survey before any authoring.
future_pass_recommendation.observed_original_features: Layered freestanding painted mountain/castle profiles; curved timber platform lip; continuous rising decorated bridge parapets. The new photos corroborate bridges/interior and do not add a new range photograph.
future_pass_recommendation.candidate_survey_box: Current adaptation board is x80..88, y1..6, z30. An initial bounded survey may inspect only its foreground strip x80..88, y1..3, z31..32 for a one-block-thick stepped silhouette. This is a proposed investigation box, NOT a chosen/clear/approved footprint, and is not an original-game measurement.
future_pass_recommendation.do_not_assume_box_is_free: Current hay/target structures, kitchen approach routes and every currently valid Skill lane/corridor must be checked in final serialized voxels; static reference work did not check these cells or choose placements.
protected_features: Existing board cells x80..88/y1..6/z30 and GP21 firing rail cells x80..81 and x85..92/y1/z38.
Entire three-column firing opening x82..84 at z38 including expanded fence collision envelope; all five actor-offset firing checks and 13-sample arrival corridor.
Every target, dummy, hay support, all floors and doors, the unique fletching table, all seven gate routes, eight local routes, both bridge decks/approaches, Maze anchor and 678 reservations.
No full campus, bridge-width, target-count, axis-orientation or original full-perimeter claim from these photos.
future_pass_recommendation.adaptations_to_label: Voxel dimensions, chosen material palette, stepped silhouette geometry, depth, any exact placement and collision bounds would be Minecraft adaptations. A full volumetric turret or terrain mountain would exceed the pictured scenic cutout evidence.
future_pass_recommendation.platform: Keep current floor/circulation. The lip is visibly timber and curved, but a raised Minecraft curb/fence could consume route/collision space; establish a survey with actor-expanded shapes before proposing such cells. Exact original curve extent remains unknown.
future_pass_recommendation.bridge: Retain current decks and approaches. New daytime view 91147839 strengthens the case for broad decorated rising side members and exterior post lamps, but no deck width/arch rise/bracing dimensions are established. No bridge narrowing or route change follows.
future_pass_recommendation.interior: 350434796 strengthens the existing stone-arch and timber stair-hand-rail relationship. Preserve passages and stair treads; exact furnishing, room dimensions and light levels remain open.
future_pass_recommendation.native_status: Native lighting, walking, collision, two-Hero passing, saved-world acceptance and Skill arrival calibration remain unrun; no production change is authorized by the reference audit alone.
